row:
Health4theworld Academy aims to build the largest online free of cost educational channel in medicine to provide reliable education from the leading close to 100 medical professors from top institutions worldwide. This multiple speciality channel includes content for doctors, medical students, residents, fellows, community health care workers, nurses and allied medical staff. This can be accessed in multiple languages. This movement has been by inspired by unmet medical needs worldwide. We believe every health care professional should have free of cost access to life saving knowledge from the best to save lives of their patients. 
Join the movement to spread this knowledge by subscribing to this channel and sharing it with your friends.
Please see the disclaimer page https://health4theworld.org/academy/medical-content-disclaimer/
